mechanism: Naproxen may increase fluphenazine levels through CYP450 inhibition and competition for protein binding, while both drugs increase CNS depression and extrapyramidal side effect risk; NSAIDs also increase GI ulceration risk when combined with antipsychotics.
action: Monitor for increased extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, and GI bleeding; consider alternative analgesic or use lowest effective NSAID dose with gastroprotection; avoid chronic concurrent use if possible.
